description: This file implements a command-line tool 'mailsplit' used to split mbox or Maildir formatted mailbox files into individual message files. It includes functions for parsing mailbox formats, reading message boundaries, and handling file system operations.

methods.name: int is_from_line(const char * line,int len)
methods.description: Checks if a given line follows the 'From ' format with an embedded date and year, indicating the start of an email message in mbox format.

methods.name: int split_one(FILE * mbox,const char * name,int allow_bare)
methods.description: Extracts a single email message from the mailbox file and writes it to a new file, based on 'From ' lines and mailbox parsing rules.

methods.name: int populate_maildir_list(struct string_list * list,const char * path)
methods.description: Populates a list with filenames from specified Maildir subfolders ('cur', 'new') within a given directory.

methods.name: int maildir_filename_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting filenames within a Maildir, prioritizing numeric parts for sorting messages.

methods.name: int split_maildir(const char * maildir,const char * dir,int nr_prec,int skip)
methods.description: Splits messages stored in a Maildir directory into individual files, generating filenames based on a given pattern.

methods.name: int split_mbox(const char * file,const char * dir,int allow_bare,int nr_prec,int skip)
methods.description: Splits a traditional mbox file into individual message files, handling mailbox boundaries and message formatting.

methods.name: int cmd_mailsplit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command-line interface function that parses arguments and coordinates the splitting of mailbox files into message files.

ctags.name: cmd_mailsplit
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: split_maildir
ctags.signature: (const char * maildir,const char * dir,int nr_prec,int skip)

ctags.name: split_mbox
ctags.pattern: /^static int split_mbox(const char *file, const char *dir, int allow_bare,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * file,const char * dir,int allow_bare,int nr_prec,int skip)

ctags.name: split_one
ctags.pattern: /^static int split_one(FILE *mbox, const char *name, int allow_bare)$/
